title: \textbf{Homogenization: Triadic Partition, Cube Measure, Cube Average, and Telescoping Increment Lemmas in Lean 4

claims.statement: For $d \in \mathbb{N}$, scale exponent $m \in \mathbb{N}$, and center $z \in \mathbb{R}^d$, the triadic cube $\mathrm{cube}(m,z) \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ is defined coordinatewise by \[ \mathrm{cube}(m,z) = \bigcap_{i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,d} \Bigl\{ x \in \mathbb{R}^d \;\Big|\; z_i - \frac{3^m}{2} \le x_i < z_i + \frac{3^m}{2} \Bigr\}. \]
claims.title: Half-Open Triadic Cube

claims.statement: For every $d, m \in \mathbb{N}$ and $z \in \mathbb{R}^d$, the set $\mathrm{cube}(m,z)$ is measurable and its Lebesgue volume satisfies \[ \mu(\mathrm{cube}(m,z)) = (3^m)^d > 0, \qquad \mu_{\mathbb{R}}(\mathrm{cube}(m,z)) = 3^{md} > 0. \]
claims.title: Exact Lebesgue Measure of the Triadic Cube -- \texttt{measure\_cube} \& \texttt{measureReal\_cube\_eq}

claims.statement: Let $\mathrm{cubeAvg}(m,z,g) := \mu_{\mathbb{R}}(\mathrm{cube}(m,z))^{-1} \int_{x \in \mathrm{cube}(m,z)} g(x)\,d\mu(x)$. Then: • For $g_1, g_2$ integrable on $\mathrm{cube}(m,z)$, $\mathrm{cubeAvg}(m,z,g_1 + g_2) = \mathrm{cubeAvg}(m,z,g_1) + \mathrm{cubeAvg}(m,z,g_2)$. • For $c \in \mathbb{R}$, $\mathrm{cubeAvg}(m,z, c \cdot g) = c \cdot \mathrm{cubeAvg}(m,z,g)$. • For constant $c \in E$, $\mathrm{cubeAvg}(m,z, x \mapsto c) = c$.
claims.title: Normalized Cube Average Properties -- \texttt{cubeAvg\_add}, \texttt{cubeAvg\_smul}, \texttt{cubeAvg\_const}

claims.statement: For every $m, K \in \mathbb{N}$, $z \in \mathbb{R}^d$, and field $g : \mathbb{R}^d \to E$: \[ \mathrm{cubeAvg}(m+K,z,g) - \mathrm{cubeAvg}(m,z,g) = \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} \bigl(\mathrm{cubeAvg}(m+k+1,z,g) - \mathrm{cubeAvg}(m+k,z,g)\bigr), \] and consequently \[ \bigl\|\mathrm{cubeAvg}(m+K,z,g) - \mathrm{cubeAvg}(m,z,g)\bigr\| \le \sum_{k=0}^{K-1} \bigl\|\mathrm{cubeAvg}(m+k+1,z,g) - \mathrm{cubeAvg}(m+k,z,g)\bigr\|. \]
claims.title: Multi-Scale Telescoping Increment Identity and Norm Bound -- \texttt{telescoping\_increments} \& \texttt{norm\_Increment\_le\_sum}
